events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Stuttgart 1, Viking 0. Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Angelo Stiller.
Goal! Stuttgart 1, Viking 1. Zlatko Tripic (Viking) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Henrik Bjørdal.
Goal! Stuttgart 2, Viking 1. Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Deniz Undav with a through ball.
Goal! Stuttgart 3, Viking 1. Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Deniz Undav.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Kristoffer Askildsen (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Stuttgart 3, Viking 1.
Peter Christiansen (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joe Bell (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Dzenan Pejcinovic replaces Ermedin Demirovic.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Josha Vagnoman replaces Jamie Leweling.
Substitution, Viking. Erik Botheim replaces Joe Bell.
Substitution, Viking. Henrik Falchener replaces Jesper Daland.
Substitution, Viking. Simen Kvia-Egeskog replaces Tobias Moi.
Substitution, Viking. Vetle Auklend replaces Kristoffer Haugen.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Ramon Hendriks replaces Finn Jeltsch.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Leo Sauer replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
Substitution, Viking. Herman Haugen replaces Henrik Heggheim.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Ameen Al-Dakhil replaces Maximilian Mittelstädt.
Second Half ends, Stuttgart 3, Viking 1.
